label.brand_name: ATTITUDE Super Leaves Hand Sanitizer Orange Leaves

sections.indications_and_usage: Hand Sanitizer to help reduce bacteria that potentially can cause disease. For use when soap and water are not available.
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions: For adults and children 2 years and older. Supervise children when they use this products. Rub thoroughly into hands for at least 30 seconds. Allow to dry.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: For external use only. When using this product avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Stop use and consult a health care professional if irritation or redness develops and persists for more than 72 hours. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, call a poison control centre or get medical help right away. Flammability warning . Keep away from open flame and sources of heat.
